1CH 2:1.KJV: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
1CH 2:1.BHSA: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רְאוּבֵ֤ן שִׁמְעֹון֙ לֵוִ֣י וִיהוּדָ֔ה יִשָׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבֻלֽוּן׃

1CH 2:2.KJV: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
1CH 2:2.BHSA: דָּ֚ן יֹוסֵ֣ף וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן נַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְאָשֵֽׁר׃ ס

1CH 2:3.KJV: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
1CH 2:3.BHSA: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֤ר וְאֹונָן֙ וְשֵׁלָ֔ה שְׁלֹושָׁה֙ נֹ֣ולַד לֹ֔ו מִבַּת־שׁ֖וּעַ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑ית וַיְהִ֞י עֵ֣ר׀ בְּכֹ֣ור יְהוּדָ֗ה רַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַיְמִיתֵֽהוּ׃ ס

1CH 2:4.KJV: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
1CH 2:4.BHSA: וְתָמָר֙ כַּלָּתֹ֔ו יָ֥לְדָה לֹּ֖ו אֶת־פֶּ֣רֶץ וְאֶת־זָ֑רַח כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס

1CH 2:5.KJV: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

1CH 2:6.KJV: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
1CH 2:6.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י זֶ֗רַח זִ֠מְרִי וְאֵיתָ֧ן וְהֵימָ֛ן וְכַלְכֹּ֥ל וָדָ֖רַע כֻּלָּ֥ם חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ ס

1CH 2:7.KJV: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
1CH 2:7.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֖י כַּרְמִ֑י עָכָר֙ עֹוכֵ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָעַ֖ל בַּחֵֽרֶם׃ ס

1CH 2:8.KJV: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

1CH 2:9.KJV: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
1CH 2:9.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י חֶצְרֹ֖ון אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֹולַד־לֹ֑ו אֶת־יְרַחְמְאֵ֥ל וְאֶת־רָ֖ם וְאֶת־כְּלוּבָֽי׃

1CH 2:10.KJV: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
1CH 2:10.BHSA: וְרָ֖ם הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־עַמִּינָדָ֑ב וְעַמִּינָדָב֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־נַחְשֹׁ֔ון נְשִׂ֖יא בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

1CH 2:11.KJV: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
1CH 2:11.BHSA: וְנַחְשֹׁון֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־שַׂלְמָ֔א וְשַׂלְמָ֖א הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־בֹּֽעַז׃

1CH 2:12.KJV: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
1CH 2:12.BHSA: וּבֹ֨עַז֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־עֹובֵ֔ד וְעֹובֵ֖ד הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־יִשָֽׁי׃

1CH 2:13.KJV: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
1CH 2:13.BHSA: וְאִישַׁ֛י הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־בְּכֹרֹ֖ו אֶת־אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַאֲבִינָדָב֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְשִׁמְעָ֖א הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃

1CH 2:14.KJV: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

1CH 2:15.KJV: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

1CH 2:16.KJV: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
1CH 2:16.BHSA: ואחיתיהם צְרוּיָ֣ה וַאֲבִיגָ֑יִל וּבְנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֗ה אַבְשַׁ֛י וְיֹואָ֥ב וַעֲשָׂה־אֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

1CH 2:17.KJV: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
1CH 2:17.BHSA: וַאֲבִיגַ֕יִל יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־עֲמָשָׂ֑א וַאֲבִ֣י עֲמָשָׂ֔א יֶ֖תֶר הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִֽי׃

1CH 2:18.KJV: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
1CH 2:18.BHSA: וְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־חֶצְרֹ֗ון הֹולִ֛יד אֶת־עֲזוּבָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־יְרִיעֹ֑ות וְאֵ֣לֶּה בָנֶ֔יהָ יֵ֥שֶׁר וְשֹׁובָ֖ב וְאַרְדֹּֽון׃

1CH 2:19.KJV: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
1CH 2:19.BHSA: וַתָּ֖מָת עֲזוּבָ֑ה וַיִּֽקַּֽח־לֹ֤ו כָלֵב֙ אֶת־אֶפְרָ֔ת וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֹ֖ו אֶת־חֽוּר׃

1CH 2:20.KJV: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
1CH 2:20.BHSA: וְחוּר֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־אוּרִ֔י וְאוּרִ֖י הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־בְּצַלְאֵֽל׃ ס

1CH 2:21.KJV: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
1CH 2:21.BHSA: וְאַחַ֗ר בָּ֤א חֶצְרֹון֙ אֶל־בַּת־מָכִיר֙ אֲבִ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וְה֣וּא לְקָחָ֔הּ וְה֖וּא בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֹ֖ו אֶת־שְׂגֽוּב׃

1CH 2:22.KJV: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
1CH 2:22.BHSA: וּשְׂג֖וּב הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־יָאִ֑יר וַֽיְהִי־לֹ֗ו עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלֹושׁ֙ עָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

1CH 2:23.KJV: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
1CH 2:23.BHSA: וַיִּקַּ֣ח גְּשֽׁוּר־וַ֠אֲרָם אֶת־חַוֹּ֨ת יָאִ֧יר מֵאִתָּ֛ם אֶת־קְנָ֥ת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים עִ֑יר כָּל־אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֖י מָכִ֥יר אֲבִי־גִלְעָֽד׃

1CH 2:24.KJV: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
1CH 2:24.BHSA: וְאַחַ֥ר מֹות־חֶצְרֹ֖ון בְּכָלֵ֣ב אֶפְרָ֑תָה וְאֵ֤שֶׁת חֶצְרֹון֙ אֲבִיָּ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד לֹ֔ו אֶת־אַשְׁח֖וּר אֲבִ֥י תְקֹֽועַ׃

1CH 2:25.KJV: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
1CH 2:25.BHSA: וַיִּהְי֧וּ בְנֵי־יְרַחְמְאֵ֛ל בְּכֹ֥ור חֶצְרֹ֖ון הַבְּכֹ֣ור׀ רָ֑ם וּבוּנָ֥ה וָאֹ֛רֶן וָאֹ֖צֶם אֲחִיָּֽה׃

1CH 2:26.KJV: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
1CH 2:26.BHSA: וַתְּהִ֨י אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֛רֶת לִֽירַחְמְאֵ֖ל וּשְׁמָ֣הּ עֲטָרָ֑ה הִ֖יא אֵ֥ם אֹונָֽם׃ ס

1CH 2:27.KJV: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
1CH 2:27.BHSA: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־רָ֖ם בְּכֹ֣ור יְרַחְמְאֵ֑ל מַ֥עַץ וְיָמִ֖ין וָעֵֽקֶר׃

1CH 2:28.KJV: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab and Abishur.
1CH 2:28.BHSA: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־אֹונָ֖ם שַׁמַּ֣י וְיָדָ֑ע וּבְנֵ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִישֽׁוּר׃

1CH 2:29.KJV: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
1CH 2:29.BHSA: וְשֵׁ֛ם אֵ֥שֶׁת אֲבִישׁ֖וּר אֲבִיהָ֑יִל וַתֵּ֣לֶד לֹ֔ו אֶת־אַחְבָּ֖ן וְאֶת־מֹולִֽיד׃

1CH 2:30.KJV: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
1CH 2:30.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב סֶ֣לֶד וְאַפָּ֑יִם וַיָּ֥מָת סֶ֖לֶד לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃ ס

1CH 2:31.KJV: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
1CH 2:31.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י אַפַּ֖יִם יִשְׁעִ֑י וּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׁעִי֙ שֵׁשָׁ֔ן וּבְנֵ֥י שֵׁשָׁ֖ן אַחְלָֽי׃

1CH 2:32.KJV: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
1CH 2:32.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֤י יָדָע֙ אֲחִ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י יֶ֖תֶר וְיֹונָתָ֑ן וַיָּ֥מָת יֶ֖תֶר לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃ ס

1CH 2:33.KJV: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
1CH 2:33.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֥י יֹונָתָ֖ן פֶּ֣לֶת וְזָזָ֑א אֵ֥לֶּה הָי֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃

1CH 2:34.KJV: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
1CH 2:34.BHSA: וְלֹֽא־הָיָ֧ה לְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנֹ֑ות וּלְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן עֶ֥בֶד מִצְרִ֖י וּשְׁמֹ֥ו יַרְחָֽע׃

1CH 2:35.KJV: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
1CH 2:35.BHSA: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שֵׁשָׁ֧ן אֶת־בִּתֹּ֛ו לְיַרְחָ֥ע עַבְדֹּ֖ו לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֹ֖ו אֶת־עַתָּֽי׃

1CH 2:36.KJV: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
1CH 2:36.BHSA: וְעַתַּי֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־נָתָ֔ן וְנָתָ֖ן הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־זָבָֽד׃

1CH 2:37.KJV: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
1CH 2:37.BHSA: וְזָבָד֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־אֶפְלָ֔ל וְאֶפְלָ֖ל הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־עֹובֵֽד׃

1CH 2:38.KJV: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
1CH 2:38.BHSA: וְעֹובֵד֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־יֵה֔וּא וְיֵה֖וּא הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָֽה׃

1CH 2:39.KJV: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
1CH 2:39.BHSA: וַעֲזַרְיָה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־חָ֔לֶץ וְחֶ֖לֶץ הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃

1CH 2:40.KJV: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
1CH 2:40.BHSA: וְאֶלְעָשָׂה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־סִֽסְמָ֔י וְסִסְמַ֖י הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־שַׁלּֽוּם׃

1CH 2:41.KJV: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
1CH 2:41.BHSA: וְשַׁלּוּם֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־יְקַמְיָ֔ה וִֽיקַמְיָ֖ה הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֱלִישָׁמָֽע׃

1CH 2:42.KJV: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
1CH 2:42.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֤י כָלֵב֙ אֲחִ֣י יְרַחְמְאֵ֔ל מֵישָׁ֥ע בְּכֹרֹ֖ו ה֣וּא אֲבִי־זִ֑יף וּבְנֵ֥י מָרֵשָׁ֖ה אֲבִ֥י חֶבְרֹֽון׃

1CH 2:43.KJV: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
1CH 2:43.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֖י חֶבְרֹ֑ון קֹ֥רַח וְתַפֻּ֖חַ וְרֶ֥קֶם וָשָֽׁמַע׃

1CH 2:44.KJV: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
1CH 2:44.BHSA: וְשֶׁ֣מַע הֹולִ֔יד אֶת־רַ֖חַם אֲבִ֣י יָרְקֳעָ֑ם וְרֶ֖קֶם הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־שַׁמָּֽי׃

1CH 2:45.KJV: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.

1CH 2:46.KJV: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
1CH 2:46.BHSA: וְעֵיפָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ כָּלֵ֔ב יָֽלְדָ֛ה אֶת־חָרָ֥ן וְאֶת־מֹוצָ֖א וְאֶת־גָּזֵ֑ז וְחָרָ֖ן הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־גָּזֵֽז׃ ס

1CH 2:47.KJV: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
1CH 2:47.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֖י יָהְדָּ֑י רֶ֧גֶם וְיֹותָ֛ם וְגֵישָׁ֥ן וָפֶ֖לֶט וְעֵיפָ֥ה וָשָֽׁעַף׃

1CH 2:48.KJV: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
1CH 2:48.BHSA: פִּלֶ֤גֶשׁ כָּלֵב֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה יָ֥לַד שֶׁ֖בֶר וְאֶֽת־תִּרְחֲנָֽה׃

1CH 2:49.KJV: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
1CH 2:49.BHSA: וַתֵּ֗לֶד שַׁ֚עַף אֲבִ֣י מַדְמַנָּ֔ה אֶת־שְׁוָ֛א אֲבִ֥י מַכְבֵּנָ֖ה וַאֲבִ֣י גִבְעָ֑א וּבַת־כָּלֵ֖ב עַכְסָֽה׃ ס

1CH 2:50.KJV: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim.
1CH 2:50.BHSA: אֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י כָלֵ֔ב בֶּן־ח֖וּר בְּכֹ֣ור אֶפְרָ֑תָה שֹׁובָ֕ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃

1CH 2:51.KJV: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
1CH 2:51.BHSA: שַׂלְמָא֙ אֲבִ֣י בֵֽית־לָ֔חֶם חָרֵ֖ף אֲבִ֥י בֵית־גָּדֵֽר׃

1CH 2:52.KJV: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
1CH 2:52.BHSA: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בָנִים֙ לְשֹׁובָ֔ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים הָרֹאֶ֖ה חֲצִ֥י הַמְּנֻחֹֽות׃

1CH 2:53.KJV: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites,
1CH 2:53.BHSA: וּמִשְׁפְּחֹות֙ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים הַיִּתְרִי֙ וְהַפּוּתִ֔י וְהַשֻּׁמָתִ֖י וְהַמִּשְׁרָעִ֑י מֵאֵ֗לֶּה יָצְאוּ֙ הַצָּ֣רְעָתִ֔י וְהָאֶשְׁתָּ֖אֻֽלִֽי׃ ס

1CH 2:54.KJV: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
1CH 2:54.BHSA: בְּנֵ֣י שַׂלְמָ֗א בֵּ֥ית לֶ֨חֶם֙ וּנְטֹ֣ופָתִ֔י עַטְרֹ֖ות בֵּ֣ית יֹואָ֑ב וַחֲצִ֥י הַמָּנַחְתִּ֖י הַצָּרְעִֽי׃

1CH 2:55.KJV: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
1CH 2:55.BHSA: וּמִשְׁפְּחֹ֤ות סֹפְרִים֙ ישׁבו יַעְבֵּ֔ץ תִּרְעָתִ֥ים שִׁמְעָתִ֖ים שׂוּכָתִ֑ים הֵ֚מָּה הַקִּינִ֣ים הַבָּאִ֔ים מֵחַמַּ֖ת אֲבִ֥י בֵית־רֵכָֽב׃ ס

records.name: Abigail

records.name: Abinadab
records.distinguisher: second-born (1CH 2:13) son of Jesse (1SA 16:8) brother of David

records.name: Abishai
records.distinguisher: son of Zeruiah and Joab's brother (1SA 26:6), chief of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:18)

records.name: Amasa
records.distinguisher: set over David's army in place of Joab (2SA 17:25)

records.name: Asahel
records.distinguisher: brother of Joab and Abishai (2SA 2:18), sixth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:24)

records.name: Asher

records.distinguisher: the Canaanitess, mother of Judah's first three sons (1CH 2:3)

records.name: Benjamin

records.name: Bezalel
records.distinguisher: called by G-d in the construction of the tabernacle (EXO 31:2)

records.name: Calcol

records.name: Carmi

records.name: Chelubai
records.distinguisher: son of Hezron, son of Perez (1CH 2:9)

records.name: Dan
records.distinguisher: fifth-born son of Jacob (GEN 30:5), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid

records.name: Darda
records.distinguisher: son of Zerah (1CH 2:6).  Solomon was wiser than him (1KI 4:31)

records.name: Eker
